_note: DESIGN.md: every celebrity mini-game is introduced by Chelsea Clinton, who explains how empowering and fun this is going to be. Her lines are her own published words (sources below). intros: mini-game id -> lines; '_default' is used for any game without its own.

_default: Sometimes being a girl isn't easy.
So, if anyone ever tells you no, if anyone says your voice isn't important or your dreams are too big, remember these women.
They persisted and so should you.
It's always better to ask and be told no than to not ask at all.

She Persisted (2017) and She Persisted Around the World (2018), closing
